label: done
title: Add the driving interaction
details: Implemented and human-verified the complete prototype interaction. The car is a 55-percent-scale chassis with two physical wheels and precise collision detection. `D`/Right drives right, `A`/Left brakes then drives left, `R` resets, and vertical keys remain unbound. Direct chassis torque was removed. Vehicle creation waits for window layout; resize relocation and manual/automatic reset replace bodies and joints to avoid solver impulses. Updated project, design, system, and decision artifacts. Evidence: `swift build` passes, `swift run StatusDriverModelTests` reports 8/8 checks, automated physics probes showed stable idle/directional/reset behavior and were removed, and the human verified the final interaction.

label: done
title: Grill telemetry integration
details: Accepted the first genuine telemetry contract. Aggregate whole-system CPU from Mach HOST_CPU_LOAD_INFO is the default terrain source; explicit `--synthetic` remains. An application-owned AsyncStream samples every 150 ms independently of rendering, calculates wrapping tick deltas, applies a roughly 0.75-second EMA, prefills flat startup history, carries source/availability state, reuses the last value on failure, skips unbounded deadline catch-up, and cancels with the app session. A minimal upper-left annotation shows CPU, synthetic, or unavailable state. Local research confirmed unprivileged CPU reads on macOS 26.2. Decisions 0006 through 0008, PROJECT.md, DESIGN.md, and research evidence are synchronized. Approved implementation order: build the telemetry pipeline in isolation, then connect it to terrain and presentation.
